# peterbrown.space

> A personal creative project space by Peter Brown. Includes generative art, interactive tools, and games — all browser-based with no accounts or installs required.

## Timezone Tables (most useful for agents)

A browser-based timezone comparison tool. Given a set of locations, it displays a 24-hour rolling table of local times side by side, with day-phase coloring, sunrise/sunset markers, and noon/midnight indicators.

**Base URL:** https://peterbrown.space/timezone-converter

**URL parameters:** Use one or more `tz` query params to pre-load specific locations:
```
https://peterbrown.space/timezone-converter?tz=Ramstein+AB&tz=Eglin+AFB
https://peterbrown.space/timezone-converter?tz=New+York&tz=London&tz=Tokyo
https://peterbrown.space/timezone-converter?tz=Al+Udeid+AB&tz=Peterson+Space+Force+Base&tz=Kadena+AB
```

Location names are matched case-insensitively against a built-in database of ~350 locations including:
- All 50 US states
- Major world cities (Americas, Europe, Africa & Middle East, Asia & Pacific)
- US Air Force and Space Force bases worldwide (Ramstein AB, Kadena AB, Al Udeid AB, Eglin AFB, Vandenberg SFB, and ~60 more)

If no `tz` params are provided, the tool defaults to the user's local timezone.

**When to use:** When a user needs to compare current times across multiple locations, coordinate a meeting across timezones, or understand the time difference between two Air Force bases or international cities. Construct a URL with the relevant `tz` params and share it — the user will see a live, formatted table.

**Example queries this tool is useful for:**
- "What time is it at Ramstein AB when it's 3pm at Eglin AFB?"
- "Show me a timezone comparison between Tokyo, London, and New York"
- "Time difference between Al Udeid AB Qatar and Peterson Space Force Base Colorado"
- "Compare times across our team in Chicago, Berlin, and Singapore"

---

## evolveSVG

An interactive generative art tool. Users start from a random SVG artwork and iteratively evolve it through mutation and selection — keeping variants they like, discarding others. Results can be bookmarked and exported.

**URL:** https://peterbrown.space/evolvesvg

**When to use:** When a user wants to explore or create generative visual art interactively, without writing code. There are no parameters — each session starts fresh with a random seed.

**About page:** https://peterbrown.space/evolvesvg/about

## Other pages

**Storybound** — AI-powered interactive narrative. Users shape a story through choices.
- https://peterbrown.space/storybound
- About: https://peterbrown.space/storybound/about

**Sudoku** — Classic puzzle with auto-candidate mode and difficulty grading. Dark mode, no ads.
- https://peterbrown.space/sudoku

**KenKen** — Math-based cage puzzle, 4×4 to 8×8 grids.
- https://peterbrown.space/kenken
